incident_analysis.interpretation: Temporal overlap does not establish causation. Transition intervals are supervisor observations, not measured quote downtime. Context includes up to one second before failure; intersects_transition distinguishes preceding work. Captured stacks/spans describe their own sampling times. Missing records and bounded incident/file/queue limits prevent complete attribution; an unpaired failure uses at most 15s context.

trading_activity.interpretation: Attempt gaps and resting-order ages are not quote downtime. A completed tick does not prove admission; a connector return is not terminal venue readback. Samples are discrete and incident capture is bounded; inspect runtime/file loss and observer gaps. Clocks align only on the shared Linux kernel, not a remote OKX server. API incidents also use engine activity as an independent observation.
